watchFor: 沉積增加材料、蝕刻選擇性移除材料，兩者需要搭配。

高深寬比及三維結構使均勻性與選擇性同時重要。
watchForEn: Deposition adds material while etching removes selected material; the processes work together.

guides.title: 電荷捕捉記憶體閘極工程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Charge-trap memory gate engineering: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「電荷儲存層：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：電荷捕捉層和導電浮閘的儲存方式不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Charge-storage layer: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Charge-trap layers store charge differently from conductive floating gates. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜電荷儲存層：建立模型：電荷捕捉層和導電浮閘的儲存方式不同；局域捕捉電荷可具有不同能階。
觀察站 2｜阻擋層：建立模型：阻擋層服務的界面不同於穿隧層；閘極注入可和通道注入競爭。
觀察站 3｜記憶窗驗收：故障判讀與驗證：平均記憶窗不能代表最弱單元裕量；錯誤更正能力不能取代元件量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Charge-storage layer: construct and analyze: Charge-trap layers store charge differently from conductive floating gates; Localized trapped charges occupy different energies.
Observation station 2 | Blocking layer: construct and analyze: The blocking layer serves a different interface from the tunnel layer; Gate injection can compete with channel injection.
Observation station 3 | Memory-window acceptance: diagnose and verify: Mean window does not represent weakest-cell margin; Error correction does not replace device measurements.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「阻擋層：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「記憶窗驗收：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Blocking layer: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Memory-window acceptance: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把捕捉層畫成等電位金屬浮閘」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「互換兩層而假定能帶條件不變」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Drawing a trap layer as an equipotential metallic floating gate", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Swapping the layers while assuming unchanged bands", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.overview: 從「電荷捕捉記憶體閘極工程」延伸比較垂直 NAND 記憶體堆疊、鐵電記憶體氧化鉿薄膜：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Charge-trap memory gate engineering by comparing Vertical NAND memory stacking and Hafnia thin films for ferroelectric memory: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 垂直 NAND 的每層單元可利用電荷捕捉堆疊改變閾值，結構幾何與電荷保持共同決定窗口。
related.transferEn: Each vertical NAND cell can use a charge-trap stack to shift threshold; geometry and retention jointly determine the window.
related.difference: 垂直堆疊課研究字串、層間一致性及整合；閘極課研究捕捉、穿隧與阻擋層。層數增加不自動改善單元保持。
related.differenceEn: Stacking studies strings, layer uniformity and integration; gate engineering studies trapping, tunneling and blocking layers. More layers do not inherently improve retention.
practice: 將穿隧／捕捉／阻擋層放進一個垂直單元。
比較層位置造成的閾值分布差異。
分開相鄰單元干擾與單層漏電假說。
practiceEn: Place tunnel, trap and blocking layers in one vertical cell.
Compare threshold distributions by layer position.
Separate neighboring-cell interference from single-layer leakage hypotheses.

related.why: 垂直 NAND 的每層單元可利用電荷捕捉堆疊改變閾值，結構幾何與電荷保持共同決定窗口。
related.whyEn: Each vertical NAND cell can use a charge-trap stack to shift threshold; geometry and retention jointly determine the window.

related.transfer: 兩者都以閘堆疊的內部狀態改變讀取電性，需同時比較窗口、保持與耐久。
related.transferEn: Both modify readout through an internal gate-stack state, requiring window, retention and endurance comparisons.
related.difference: 電荷捕捉依賴載子陷阱；鐵電依賴可切換極化。相似遲滯窗口不能證明相同機制或相同寫入條件。
related.differenceEn: Charge trapping relies on carrier traps; ferroelectrics rely on switchable polarization. Similar hysteresis does not prove identical mechanisms or programming conditions.
practice: 畫陷阱電荷與極化方向兩種狀態圖。
比較保持漂移與循環退化的觀察量。
提出能區分捕捉效應與鐵電切換的量測。
practiceEn: Draw separate trapped-charge and polarization-state diagrams.
Compare observables for retention drift and cycling degradation.
Propose measurements distinguishing trapping from ferroelectric switching.

courses.summary: 本課以「imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從電荷儲存層、能階深度到記憶窗驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From Charge-storage layer and Trap depth to Memory-window acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
